$comment: Explicit slice manifest for the code-review sweep (ctf/scripts/reviewCodebaseSlice.mjs).
The sweep names a slice after the folders that share a name across the source layers. Two things
cannot be derived from that name, so they are declared here instead of guessed:
contractPrefix — which ctf/docs/contracts/<PREFIX>_* files govern this slice. The default is the
slice name upper-snake-cased, which is wrong wherever a surface is served by another plugin's
contracts. Getting this wrong means the reviewer is handed NO contracts and then invents what
the contract must say (that is what produced issue #2207, which asserted a plugin id the feed
aliases — folder names this slice used to have. Findings are deduped against issues titled
'Code review (<slice>): ...', so a rename hides every earlier decision and dismissed findings
come back. #2207 is #1876 refiled 17 days later, purely because api/hub became api/commons.
extraPaths — folders (or files) outside the name-grouped layers that belong to this slice: a page
folder whose name does not match its plugin (app/survey is the quora-deletion-survey entry screen,
app/knowledge the comic one). Claimed before any name match, so a declared path inside another
slice's page folder (app/plugin/unlock) goes where it was declared. Undeclared, such a page is
reviewed in the web-pages catch-all, away from the routes it calls.
Only slices that need one of these appear here; everything else uses the derived default.
Add an entry when you rename a slice folder, or when a slice's contracts live under another name.

bug-reports.note: The api, lib and components folders are named bug-reports, but the contracts are the BUG_REPORTING_* files, after the bug-reporting plugin registry slug.

commons.note: Member-facing surface over the feed plugin: its routes call lib/feed and it is governed by the FEED_* contracts. `commons` is not a registered plugin slug.

community-shell.note: The shell that renders the Commons/feed surfaces; no contracts of its own.

questions.note: Mints Stream credentials for the Questions screen over feed_questions, a Feed table; governed by the FEED_* contracts.

quora-deletion-survey.note: app/survey/quora-account-deletions is this plugin's entry screen; it renders components/quora-deletion-survey.

safety.note: The admin review queue for the safety reports a member attaches to a block; declared as admin.safety-report.* in the MEMBER_BLOCKS_* contracts.

unlock.note: The public Unlock page lives under app/plugin, which otherwise belongs to the legacy plugin redirect slice.

what-works.note: The public What Works page lives under app/plugin.
